name: Self-hosted gateway
note: Your own proxy in front of the model API
summary: The organization runs its own gateway between the agent and the model provider. Developers authenticate to the gateway instead of holding provider keys, and the gateway forwards requests with one organization credential, so access rules, budgets, usage tracking and audit logs sit in one place. The agent is pointed at it with a base-URL override.
how: Deploy the gateway inside your network and give it the provider credential
Issue each developer a gateway credential
Point the agent's base URL at the gateway (in Claude Code, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL or a provider-specific variant)
Set model allow-lists, budgets and telemetry in the gateway
facts: Claude Code, via Anthropic's Claude apps gateway or a gateway you already run
Claude apps gateway (ships in the claude binary), LiteLLM proxy
Central control of keys and spend, but one more service to operate
goodFor: Changing provider without touching developer machines
watchOut: A separately maintained gateway must forward the agent's new headers and fields
You deploy, patch and scale it
